title: Cancellation Terms for Northgate Care Protection Plans
content:
**Right to cancel.** The plan holder may cancel an active Northgate Care Protection Plans contract at any time. A cancelled plan takes the status cancelled, with the cancellation date as its closing date.

**Full refund.** A cancellation is refunded in full only when it is requested no later than the plan's full-refund period in calendar days after the plan purchase date and no claim has been paid. Days are counted as calendar days, the plan purchase date being day 0. The plan purchase date is the one on the company's record of the plan.

**Prorated refund.** Otherwise, where the plan refunds unused whole months, the refund is the plan charge multiplied by the unused whole months and divided by the plan's term in months, less the plan's administrative fee and, where the plan deducts claims already paid, less the claims already paid; the result is rounded to the cent and is never below zero.

**Return of the covered product.** When the covered product is returned for a refund and the plan provides that a product return cancels it, the plan is cancelled and refunded in full whatever the date.

**Where the refund goes.** The refund is paid as the plan's refund tender provides — to the original tender — against the plan charge.

## Quantities in the prorated refund

| Quantity | What it is |
|---|---|
| Plan charge | the amount of the plan's own charge entry |
| Unused whole months | the whole calendar months of the term that begin after the cancellation date, up to the coverage end date |
| Claims already paid | the total paid on the plan's settled claims whose outcome was repair, replacement or cash settlement, over the life of the plan |

The plan charge is multiplied by the unused whole months and divided by the term first; the administrative fee and then the claims already paid are taken from that prorated amount; the rounding to the cent and the floor at zero apply to the final figure.

## Full-refund period: boundary cases (hypothetical)

Take a hypothetical full-refund period of 30 calendar days and a plan purchase date of 2025-06-01 (day 0), with no claim paid.

| Cancellation requested on | Day count | Full refund |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-06-30 | day 29 | Yes |
| 2025-07-01 | day 30 | Yes — the last day counts |
| 2025-07-02 | day 31 | No — the prorated refund applies |

A cancellation requested on day 10 of the same plan after a claim has been paid is not refunded in full either; it falls to the prorated refund.

## Worked refunds (hypothetical figures)

Take a plan with coverage from 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31 on a term of 24 months.

- **Counting unused months.** Cancelled on 2025-10-20, the months beginning after that date run from November 2025 to December 2026: 14 unused whole months. Cancelled on 2025-11-01, the month beginning that day does not begin after the cancellation date, leaving 13.
- **Refund with a fee.** Plan charge 120.00, 14 unused whole months, administrative fee 25.00, no claims paid: 120.00 multiplied by 14 and divided by 24 is 70.00; less 25.00 gives a refund of 45.00.
- **Refund floored at zero.** The same plan with 60.00 of claims already paid: 70.00 less 25.00 less 60.00 would be below zero, so the refund is 0.00.
- **Rounding.** Plan charge 99.99, 14 unused whole months, no fee, no claims paid: 99.99 multiplied by 14 and divided by 24 is 58.3275, refunded as 58.33.
